messages.text: I got that wrong, Jorge, sorry. The Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin is open for orders now at $799, with 24 units left. No need to wait on anything. Happy to answer whatever you want to know about it.

I'll try my best packaging the DC06 as it just came in a box no protection. Return label is for a 10lb weight limit for everything. Other than that thanks again sent you a message in discord not sure if you had a chance to look as i know you're busy just seeing if I could be of service.
